methodology.status: app-authored editorial selection; model-assisted, not corpus sense annotation or independent native-speaker certification
methodology.scope: All available matched target forms among the original top 1,000 FrequencyWords subtitle tokens were read with their first selected sense. Potentially misleading senses were inspected against their available exact dictionary alternatives. Unmatched corpus tokens were counted separately, not described as semantically verified.
methodology.selection: Choose one ordinary contemporary target-language sense before choosing a translation language. A source-language translation must belong to this exact concept; never substitute another homonymous sense merely because a translation is available. Accepted initial senses are explicitly pinned as well as changed selections.
methodology.exclusion: Exclude only from frequency when an ordinary high-frequency use is missing or the available match is a specialist homonym, inflection lookalike, fragment or annotation artifact. Keep the valid dictionary sense in other decks. Raw token ranks are retained and missing forms are not filled from lower ranks.
methodology.ambiguity: These are editorial ordinary-use choices, not claims that corpus sense proportions have been measured. Several words have multiple legitimate common senses. Retaining one is a teaching choice; narrowly misleading senses are avoided.
methodology.corePrecedence: New explicitly authored frequencyPriority core records supersede these pre-core snapshot choices and frequency-only exclusions when they supply the previously missing everyday sense.

source.methodology: Original corpus token counts, not lemma or sense frequencies. rank is the one-based upstream row number. Punctuation, fragments, foreign words, and inflected forms are deliberately retained; nothing is filtered, normalized, lemmatized, or re-ranked here. Chinese uses zh_cn; Portuguese uses pt, not pt_br. These data do not establish CEFR levels or verified translations. A downstream lexicon match must preserve the original rank and report partial coverage instead of relabeling a subset as a complete Top N deck.
